title: RBAC: Service Accounts & Roles
description:
Create a new ServiceAccount named backend-sa in the production namespace.

Create a Role named pod-reader that allows get, watch, and list on pods in the same namespace.

Bind the Role to the ServiceAccount using a RoleBinding named backend-sa-binding.

title: Network Policies
description:
There is an existing deployment named db-app with the label tier=database in the backend namespace.

Create a NetworkPolicy named db-netpol that restricts incoming traffic to db-app. It should ONLY allow ingress traffic from pods with the label tier=frontend in the same namespace.

All other ingress traffic to db-app should be denied.

title: Persistent Storage
description:
Create a PersistentVolume named task-pv-volume with storage capacity of 1Gi, access mode ReadWriteOnce, hostPath /mnt/data, and no storageClassName.

Next, create a PersistentVolumeClaim named task-pv-claim requesting 500Mi of storage that will bind to this PV.

Finally, create a pod named task-pv-pod using the nginx image that mounts this volume at /usr/share/nginx/html.

title: Node Maintenance
description:
You need to perform maintenance on the node k3d-cka-agent-0.

Safely drain the node to ensure no workloads are interrupted. Note that there are pods managed by DaemonSets on this node, which should be ignored during the drain process.

After you have run the command, do not uncordon the node.

title: Sidecar Container Pattern
description:
A pod named legacy-app is running in the default namespace, writing logs to a file at /var/log/app.log.

Modify the pod to add a sidecar container running the busybox image. The sidecar should run the command: tail -f /var/log/app.log so that the logs can be captured via kubectl logs.

You will need to use an emptyDir volume shared between both containers to achieve this.

title: Ingress Routing
description:
Create an Ingress resource named webapp-ingress in the default namespace.

The Ingress should route requests targeting the host ckad.example.com to an existing service named webapp-service on port 80.

Assume the Ingress controller is already installed and listening on the cluster.

title: Taints and Tolerations
description:
Node k3d-cka-agent-1 has been tainted with dedicated=special-team:NoSchedule.

Create a deployment named special-app with 2 replicas using the redis image.

Ensure that the pods in this deployment tolerate the taint and are able to be scheduled on k3d-cka-agent-1.

title: Troubleshooting Services
description:
A service named frontend-svc is not able to route traffic to the pods of the frontend-deploy deployment. The deployment is running fine.

Investigate and fix the issue so that curl frontend-svc from within the cluster successfully returns the application's response.

title: Deployment Scaling
description:
There is an existing deployment named scale-deploy in the default namespace.

Scale this deployment so that it runs exactly 5 replicas.

title: Rolling Updates
description:
A deployment named web-update is running in the default namespace with the nginx:1.14 image.

Update the deployment to use the nginx:1.15 image and ensure the rollout is recorded in the deployment's annotations.

title: ConfigMaps
description:
Create a ConfigMap named app-config in the default namespace containing the key APP_ENV with the value production.

Then, create a pod named config-pod using the busybox image that sleeps for 3600 seconds, and inject the ConfigMap key as an environment variable named APP_ENV.

title: Secrets
description:
Create a generic Secret named db-credentials in the default namespace with the key password and value supersecret.

Create a pod named secret-pod using the redis image and mount this secret as a volume at /etc/secrets.

title: Init Containers
description:
Create a pod named init-demo using the nginx image.

Add an init container to this pod using the busybox image that runs the command sh -c 'echo Initialized > /work-dir/index.html'.

Mount an emptyDir volume named workdir at /work-dir in the init container and at /usr/share/nginx/html in the main container.

title: ClusterRoles
description:
Create a new ServiceAccount named node-reader-sa in the default namespace.

Create a ClusterRole named node-reader that allows get, watch, and list on nodes.

Create a ClusterRoleBinding named node-reader-binding to bind the ClusterRole to the ServiceAccount.

title: Node Affinity
description:
Label the node k3d-cka-agent-0 with disktype=ssd.

Create a pod named affinity-pod using the nginx image that must be scheduled on nodes with the label disktype=ssd using requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution nodeAffinity.

title: CronJobs
description:
Create a CronJob named hello-cron in the default namespace.

It should run every minute (* * * * *) and run a pod with the busybox image executing the command: /bin/sh -c 'echo Hello World'.

title: DaemonSets
description:
Create a DaemonSet named fluentd-ds in the kube-system namespace using the image fluentd (or any valid image like busybox with sleep command if fluentd fails to start).

Ensure that it runs one pod on every node.

title: NodePort Services
description:
There is an existing deployment named web-server in the default namespace.

Create a Service named web-server-svc to expose this deployment on NodePort 30080, mapping to port 80 on the pods.

title: NetworkPolicy Egress
description:
There is a pod named secure-pod in the default namespace with label role=secure.

Create a NetworkPolicy named secure-egress in the default namespace that restricts egress from secure-pod so it can only connect to pods with the label role=api on port 8080.

Assume ingress is allowed.

title: Troubleshooting Pods
description:
A pod named broken-pod is in a CrashLoopBackOff state due to an invalid command.

Fix the pod so that it runs successfully. It should run the busybox image and execute sleep 3600.
